title: Margo Marrone Buys Back The Organic Pharmacy
summary: Marrone sees an opportunity to bring the brand’s founding principles back into focus as interest in preventative wellness and longevity grows.

extraction.key_fact: 창업자가 더 오가닉 파머시를 되사며 브랜드의 창립 원칙을 되살리려 한다.
